name: Rafex Gold Corp.
summary: Currently in its development phase, Rafex Gold Corp. is strategically focused on the natural resource sector in Russia. A primary objective for the company involves securing ownership of a gold mining property, spanning roughly 20 square kilometers, situated in Buryatia's North Baikal region. Beyond its mining ambitions, the firm also intends to undertake forestry operations within Buryatia, providing both unhewn logs and processed lumber. The entity, originally named Sakha Enterprises Corporation, officially adopted its current designation of Rafex Gold Corp. in September 2022. Established in the year 2000, the company's main office is located in Toronto, Canada.
